name: Prusa Connect
description: Prusa Connect is Prusa Research's self-hosted server for 3D printers. Printers connect to it over your own network instead of the cloud, and the web app shows the whole fleet live, sends G-code and starts, pauses or stops prints. It has local accounts with per-printer permissions, OpenID Connect sign-in, a REST API, MQTT and webhook events, and extensions.

notes.text: Prusa Connect is a public beta (0.x): configuration and API can change between releases.
Printers need firmware 6.4.0 or newer. Use the container IP as the printer's hostname, which is limited to 20 characters.
